cohort: 419 pregnant women with pregnancy-associated thrombotic microangiopathy admitted to Ain Shams University Maternity Hospital between January 2014 and December 2018
finding: Thrombotic microangiopathy in pregnancy is associated with significant maternal and neonatal mortality and morbidity including acute kidney injury, chronic kidney injury, and ICU admission.
mod_finding: Women with thrombotic microangiopathy in pregnancy mostly delivered by cesarean section (72.1%).
